definitions.explanation: Something that cannot be understood or explained, despite efforts to make sense of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不可解|ふかかい}だ。
{不可解|ふかかい}な⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧⟦{断|ことわ}った→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{不可解|ふかかい}で⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I simply can't understand why they refused.

notes:
FORMS:
{不|ふ} (un-, in-) + {可|か} (possible) + {解|かい} (understand)
Literally: "impossible to understand"
- {不可解|ふかかい}な + noun (incomprehensible ~)
- {不可解|ふかかい}だ (it's puzzling)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不可解|ふかかい}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ - incomprehensible behavior
- {不可解|ふかかい}な⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ - mysterious incident
- {不可解|ふかかい}な⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ - mysterious death

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧ - strange, mysterious (more neutral, can be positive)
- ⟦{不可思議|ふかしぎ}→不可思議：07463_fukashigi⟧ - inexplicable (more literary)
- {謎|なぞ}めいた - enigmatic, mysterious

REGISTER:
Formal to neutral. Often used in news and serious writing.
